# Dr. Sunandan Yadav — Urologist & Andrologist in Jaipur

> Dr. Sunandan Yadav is a Consultant Urologist and Andrologist based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. He offers advanced, minimally invasive care for kidney stones, prostate concerns, men's health, urinary problems and urological conditions.

## Doctor profile
- Name: Dr. Sunandan Yadav
- Speciality: Urology and Andrology (MCh Urology)
- Qualifications: MBBS (SMS Medical College, Jaipur, 2013), MS General Surgery (SMS Jaipur, 2018), MCh Urology (Government Medical College Kota, 2022)
- Experience: 9+ years, 5000+ surgeries
- Known for: Minimally invasive urology — laser, laparoscopic and endoscopic procedures
